_source: Story steps written by hand from the Serebii (Yellow) and The Cave of Dragonflies (FRLG) walkthroughs; see scripts/build-story.py.

steps.name: Leave your house

es.name: Sal de tu casa
es.detail: Empiezas en tu cuarto, arriba: baja las escaleras y sal por la puerta.

steps.detail: You start in your room upstairs: go down the stairs and out the door.

steps.name: Head for the tall grass

es.name: Ve hacia la hierba alta
es.detail: El Prof. Oak te detiene, atrapa un Pikachu y te lleva a su laboratorio.

steps.detail: Professor Oak stops you, catches a Pikachu and takes you to his lab.

steps.name: Deliver Oak's Parcel

es.name: Entrega el Paquete de Oak
es.detail: Lleva el paquete de la tienda de Verde al Prof. Oak: te da la Pokédex.

steps.detail: Bring the parcel from the Viridian Mart back to Oak: he gives you the Pokédex.

steps.name: Watch the old man catch a Pokémon

es.name: Mira al anciano atrapar un Pokémon
es.detail: Con la Pokédex te deja pasar a la Ruta 2 y te enseña a lanzar una Poké Ball.

steps.detail: Once you have the Pokédex he lets you through to Route 2 and shows you how to throw a Poké Ball.

steps.name: Buy a drink on the Celadon roof

es.name: Compra una bebida en la azotea de Azulona
es.detail: Agua Fresca, Refresco o Limonada de las máquinas: los guardias de Azafrán tienen sed.

steps.detail: Fresh Water, Soda Pop or Lemonade from the vending machines: the Saffron guards are thirsty.

steps.name: Give a drink to a Saffron guard

es.name: Da una bebida a un guardia de Azafrán
es.detail: En cualquiera de las casetas alrededor de Azafrán: el guardia te deja entrar a la ciudad.

steps.detail: In any of the gatehouses around Saffron: the guard lets you into the city.

steps.name: Open the hideout behind the Game Corner poster

es.name: Abre la guarida tras el póster del Casino
es.detail: Vence al Rocket delante del póster y pulsa el interruptor que hay detrás.

steps.detail: Beat the Rocket in front of the poster and press the switch behind it.

steps.name: Calm the ghost of Marowak

es.name: Calma al fantasma de Marowak
es.detail: Con el Visor Silph puedes verlo y combatirlo; después se abre el paso hacia arriba.

steps.detail: With the Silph Scope you can see it and battle it; then the way up opens.

steps.name: Rescue Mr. Fuji

es.name: Rescata al Sr. Fuji
es.detail: En lo alto de la torre, tras Jessie y James. En su casa te da la Poké Flauta.

steps.detail: At the top of the tower, after Jessie and James. He thanks you with the Poké Flute at his house.
